About this radar

The SAP Development Tech Radar gives guidance on which technologies to use when building SAP applications. Every technology sits in one quadrant and one ring – the ring tells you whether to start with it, keep it or move away.

Select a blip or a filter to see details here.

ABOUT

The SAP Development Tech Radar gives guidance on which technologies to use when building SAP applications. Every technology sits in one quadrant and one ring.

Rings: Adopt → Use → Hold → Stop. Deprecated technologies are not shown on the radar but on the Deprecated page.
